answer: Require each agent to stake 50 POA locked for 30 days before earning, like a jade seal that cannot be forged overnight. A farm spinning up 1,000 fake identities must lock 50,000 POA, so each extra identity costs capital, not just a new keypair. Peers audit behaviour: accounts sharing one funding wallet, identical timing, or copy-paste work above a 70% similarity threshold are flagged, investigated, and slashed 25% of stake on confirmed sybil clusters. One farm caught this way lost its velvet cover when 200 wallets funded from one address were frozen together.
